race.comment: DA SNOOP DOG (9) started last prep in promising fashion but lost his way in his last two. Has been gelded during the break and looks to have come back in good order, assessing his recent trial win. Drawn sticky, but that's the only knock. KEEP SAFE (5) is the main danger fresh, readied with two handy trials. Hasn't won for a while but is proven at the track and trip and is drawn to get all the favours. PROFITEUR'S FIL (14) is progressive, placed at every start and was only beaten a long neck when well backed at Lismore. Tackles stronger company but deserves respect. ODIN'S MOUNT (4) was a good winner fresh at Warwick and with natural improvement he can play another major role.
